continuity_events.ddl:
CREATE TABLE continuity_events(
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        workstream_id TEXT,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        before_revision INTEGER,
        after_revision INTEGER,
        before_state_version INTEGER,
        after_state_version INTEGER,
        error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
continuity_events.name: continuity_events

continuity_focus.ddl:
CREATE TABLE continuity_focus(
        project TEXT NOT NULL,
        workspace_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
        workstream_id TEXT REFERENCES continuity_workstreams(id),
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(project, workspace_fingerprint)
    )
continuity_focus.name: continuity_focus

continuity_workstreams.ddl:
CREATE TABLE continuity_workstreams(
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        project TEXT NOT NULL,
        workspace_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
        parent_id TEXT REFERENCES continuity_workstreams(id),
        current_context_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES context_items(id),
        checkpoint_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        state_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','paused','blocked','completed','cancelled')),
        repo_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'non_git' CHECK(repo_kind IN ('git','non_git')),
        repo_branch TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        repo_root_commit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        repo_head_commit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        completed_at TEXT
    )
continuity_workstreams.name: continuity_workstreams

project_archives.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_archives(
        project TEXT PRIMARY KEY, display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', started_at TEXT, ended_at TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', source_watermark TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
project_archives.name: project_archives

project_event_sources.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_event_sources(
        source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project_events(event_id),
        binding_key TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_ref TEXT NOT NULL, source_revision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        context_item_id INTEGER, task_id INTEGER, unit_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        unit_revision INTEGER, projects TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        knowledge_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'project', evidence_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(event_id,binding_key))
project_event_sources.name: project_event_sources

CREATE TABLE project_events(
        event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project TEXT NOT NULL,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('major_change','feature','problem','milestone')),

        source_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','corrected','ignored')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
project_events.name: project_events
